The issuer has moderate leverage (total liabilities of 4,392M versus shareholders’ equity of 1,381M, i.e., ~3.2x) and weak liquidity (current ratio ~0.72), which adds refinancing/working-capital risk. However, profitability is solid for its size (EBIT margin ~22% and net margin ~9%), and positive retained earnings support capital resilience. Overall, the balance sheet strength and liquidity profile point to a lower investment-grade rating rather than speculative grade.

DECISION: BBB-
